items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I think it was the C.P. Johnson band... Alton Redd was in the band, and I used to take his place and play

ctx.x: All right. The band that I think that I remember most, and I guess it's the only band I really do remember playing with at that time, I think it was the C.P. Johnson band; they were working at the beach, and the name of the band was C.P. Johnson.

And in that band was -- Jack MacVez was in that band; I just can't remember, you know, all the musicians in the band, it was like 5 or 6 pieces, and Alton Redd was in the band, and I used to take his place and play, but that was -- I know, the name of the place on the pier in Long Beach was called the Wave Cafe, and the guys used to work; they got, I think it was $3.50 per night, and they got the kitty.
